tools.name: lrrk_check_updates
tools.description: Get exact record additions, corrections, and withdrawals between saved published version keys and the current public versions. Follow nextPage with the same knownVersions before saving the new keys. An unknown checkpoint or unavailable source means the exact comparison is incomplete.

tools.name: lrrk_find_evidence
tools.description: Search published LrrK Letters, reviewed Hardware Attack Library records, and admitted Intelligence Product metadata. Returns bounded excerpts and canonical source links. Historical paid publication bodies are never returned.

tools.name: lrrk_get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the metadata, edition, citations, evidence status and limits for one public LrrK record. A historical Intelligence Product returns metadata and its exact-edition owner handoff only.

tools.name: lrrk_map_coverage
tools.description: Map a topic and optional device class to reviewed public references and explicit gaps. Search matches are not device-specific applicability, testing, or risk verdicts.

tools.name: lrrk_find_service
tools.description: Find LrrK's human-reviewed Assess, Engage, Monitor, or one-question Evidence Brief path for a stated need. Returns criteria and a first-party link; no inquiry is submitted and no work is initiated.
